source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeInvocableActionInvokeEvidenceTest { @isTest static void rows() { Invocable.Action action = Invocable.Action.createStandardAction('localNoop'); System.assertEquals('localNoop', action.getName()); System.assertEquals('localNoop', action.getType()); System.assertEquals('', action.getNamespace()); System.assertEquals('', action.getVersion()); System.assertEquals(true, action.isStandard()); System.assertEquals(action, action.addInvocation()); System.assertEquals(action, action.setInvocationParameter('name', 'trail')); List<Invocable.Action.Result> results = action.invoke(); System.assertEquals(1, results.size()); Invocable.Action.Result result = results[0]; System.assertEquals(action, result.getAction()); System.assertEquals(true, result.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(0, result.getErrors().size()); System.assertEquals('trail', (String)result.getInvocationParameters().get('name')); System.assertEquals(0, result.getOutputParameters().size()); Invocable.Action.Result copied = (Invocable.Action.Result)result.clone(); System.assertEquals(true, copied.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals('trail', (String)copied.getInvocationParameters().get('name')); System.assertEquals(action, action.clearInvocations()); System.assertEquals(0, action.invoke().size()); Map<String,Object> first = new Map<String,Object>{'name' => 'oak'}; Map<String,Object> second = new Map<String,Object>{'name' => 'spruce'}; System.assertEquals(action, action.setInvocations(new List<Map<String,Object>>{first, second})); List<Invocable.Action.Result> replaced = action.invoke(); System.assertEquals(2, replaced.size()); System.assertEquals('oak', (String)replaced[0].getInvocationParameters().get('name')); System.assertEquals('spruce', (String)replaced[1].getInvocationParameters().get('name')); Invocable.Action versioned = Invocable.Action.createStandardAction('localVersioned', '58.0'); System.assertEquals('localVersioned', versioned.getDescribe()[0].getName()); System.assertEquals('58.0', versioned.getVersion()); Invocable.Action custom = Invocable.Action.createCustomAction('flow', 'TrailAction'); System.assertEquals('TrailAction', custom.getName()); System.assertEquals('flow', custom.getType()); System.assertEquals(false, custom.isStandard()); System.assertEquals('TrailAction', custom.getDescribe()[0].getName()); System.assertEquals('flow', custom.getDescribe()[0].getType()); Invocable.Action namespaced = Invocable.Action.createCustomAction('flow', 'ns', 'NamespacedTrail'); System.assertEquals('ns', namespaced.getNamespace()); System.assertEquals('NamespacedTrail', namespaced.getDescribe()[0].getName()); System.assertEquals('flow', namespaced.getDescribe()[0].getType()); Invocable.Action customVersioned = Invocable.Action.createCustomAction('flow', 'ns', 'VersionedTrail', '58.0'); System.assertEquals('VersionedTrail', customVersioned.getDescribe()[0].getName()); System.assertEquals('flow', customVersioned.getDescribe()[0].getType()); System.assertEquals('58.0', customVersioned.getVersion()); } }
